summary: Traws Pharma filed an 8-K solely to disclose a prospectus supplement under an existing at-the-market (ATM) offering agreement with Citizens JMP Securities. The filing updates the baby-shelf limit to $5,575,709 from a prior $50 million shelf; no new agreement, material transaction, or special situation is reported. Legal opinion from Snell Wilmer is attached. Routine capital market activity with no deal terms, board recommendation, or regulatory clock. Filing is an ordinary shelf takedown update, not a special situation.
